note: align every published crate on one Minor bump so the workspace resolves. The 0.2.1 -> 0.3.0 release mixed Minor and Patch levels across crates, so vespertide/loader/macro/lsp landed on 0.2.2 while core/query/planner/cli/config/exporter/naming landed on 0.3.0, and the root [workspace.dependencies] pins stayed at =0.2.1. cargo then failed with: failed to select a version for the requirement vespertide-core = =0.2.1, candidate versions found which didn't match: 0.3.0. Bumping every crate at the same level keeps the pins and the crate versions in lockstep.
